title: PSA: ANZ Removing Travel Insurance from Rewards Black CC (as Well as Rental Vehicle Excess in Australia) - Suggestions?
body:
Hi all,
PSA: ANZ just announced it's going to be removing complimentary travel insurance and domestic rental excess coverage from March 2027.
For a credit card that costs $375/year to have and no longer absorbed into their Home Loan Package fee (which used to cover offset accounts + CC fees), it's a pretty poor value proposition.
I figured the card was still worth it given the travel insurance being quite good and the rewards system wasn't the worst either (I just had it creating Amazon gift cards which I quickly used) but now it's definitely not.
Any suggestions from keen OzBargainers on the best alternative that has pretty good travel insurance, maybe rental excess coverage and rewards?
Cheers!
